name: Mimori Ichirou
source:
During the Pacific War, Mimori Ichirou, a petty officer and Zero fighter pilot, was about to launch a kamikaze attack on an enemy ship, when instead he finds himself crash-landing into an unfamiliar desert. As he wanders around lost, desperate for water, he is rescued by a strange princess who can transform into a dragon.

Ichirou has no idea where he is, or how to get back home - and even if he did make it back, an almost certain death would await him. Yet, the loyal soldier is determined to return to Japan no matter what it takes, in order to fulfill a promise he made...

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1783190/Hatsumira_from_the_future_undying/]Steam[/url]]
